title: Largest cities in Africa
prompt: Name the 10 most populous cities in Africa (urban population)

source.name: Wikipedia: List of cities in Africa by population

answers.name: Cairo
aliases: The City of A Thousand Minarets

fact.text: Egypt's capital was founded in 969 and became the seat of the Fatimid Caliphate in 973.
Nigeria's Lagos hosts the Dangote Refinery, set to be the world's largest oil refinery once expanded.

answers.name: Kinshasa
aliases: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo

fact.text: Called Léopoldville until 1966, the DR Congo's capital is the most populous city proper outside China.
Kenya's capital is the only capital city in the world with a national park inside its boundaries.
South Africa's largest city was founded in 1886, after gold was found on what was farmland.

answers.name: Luanda
aliases: São Paulo da Assunção de Luanda
São Paulo da Assunção de Loanda

fact.text: Angola's capital is the most populous Portuguese-speaking capital city in the world.
Sudan's capital sits where the White Nile and the Blue Nile meet.
Legend says Ivory Coast's Abidjan is named after a misheard cry: "I just cut the leaves."
Ghana's capital is named after soldier ants, a name Twi speakers gave the town and its people.
Tanzania's largest city takes its name from the Arabic for "Abode of Peace".
